arabic: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
translation: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split

arabic: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرٞ مُّسۡتَمِرّٞ
translation: Yet whenever they see a miracle, they turn away, and say, “Continuous magic.”

arabic: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرٖ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
translation: They lied, and followed their opinions, but everything has its time

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ
translation: And there came to them news containing a deterrent

arabic: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةٞۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation: Profound wisdom—but warnings are of no avail

arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ نُّكُرٍ
translation: So turn away from them. On the Day when the Caller calls to something terrible

arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادٞ مُّنتَشِرٞ
translation: Their eyes humiliated, they will emerge from the graves, as if they were swarming locusts

arabic: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرٞ
translation: Scrambling towards the Caller, the disbelievers will say, “This is a difficult Day.”

arabic: ۞ كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونٞ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ
translation: Before them the people of Noah disbelieved. They rejected Our servant, and said, “Crazy,” and he was rebuked

arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبٞ فَٱنتَصِرۡ
translation: So he appealed to his Lord, “I am overwhelmed, so help me.”

arabic: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٖ مُّنۡهَمِرٖ
translation: So We opened the floodgates of heaven with water pouring down

arabic: وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونٗا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرٖ قَدۡ قُدِرَ
translation: And We made the earth burst with springs, and the waters met for a purpose already destined

arabic: وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلۡوَٰحٖ وَدُسُرٖ
translation: And We carried him on a craft of planks and nails

arabic: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءٗ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
translation: Sailing before Our eyes; a reward for him who was rejected

arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةٗ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
translation: And We left it as a sign. Is there anyone who would take heed

arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
translation: So how were My punishment and My warnings

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
translation: We made the Quran easy to learn. Is there anyone who would learn

arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٞ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
translation: Aad denied the truth. So how were My punishment and My warnings

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا صَرۡصَرٗا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٖ مُّسۡتَمِرّٖ
translation: We unleashed upon them a screaming wind, on a day of unrelenting misery

arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٖ مُّنقَعِرٖ
translation: Plucking the people away, as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees

arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
translation: So how were My punishment and My warnings

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
translation: We made the Quran easy to remember. Is there anyone who would remember

arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation: Thamood rejected the warnings

arabic: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرٗا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدٗا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٍ
translation: They said, “Are we to follow one of us, a human being? We would then go astray, and end up in Hell

arabic: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٞ
translation: Was the message given to him, out of all of us? In fact, he is a wicked liar.”

arabic: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدٗا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ
translation: They will know tomorrow who the wicked liar is

arabic: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةٗ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ
translation: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and be patient

arabic: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبٖ مُّحۡتَضَرٞ
translation: And inform them that the water is to be shared between them; each share of drink made available

arabic: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
translation: But they called their friend, and he dared, and he slaughtered

arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
translation: So how were My punishment and My warnings

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
translation: We sent against them a single Scream, and they became like crushed hay

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
translation: We made the Quran easy to understand. Is there anyone who would understand

arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation: The people of Lot rejected the warnings

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٖۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٖ
translation: We unleashed upon them a shower of stones, except for the family of Lot; We rescued them at dawn

arabic: نِّعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ
translation: A blessing from Us. Thus We reward the thankful

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation: He had warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warnings

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
translation: They even lusted for his guest, so We obliterated their eyes. “So taste My punishment and My warnings.”

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٞ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
translation: Early morning brought upon them enduring punishment

arabic: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
translation: So taste My punishment and My warnings

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
translation: We made the Quran easy to memorize. Is there anyone who would memorize

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation: The warnings also came to the people of Pharaoh

arabic: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزٖ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
translation: They rejected Our signs, all of them, so We seized them—the seizure of an Almighty Omnipotent

arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٞ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation: Are your unbelievers better than all those? Or do you have immunity in the scriptures

arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعٞ مُّنتَصِرٞ
translation: Or do they say, “We are united, and we will be victorious”

arabic: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
translation: The multitude will be defeated, and they will turn their backs

arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
translation: The Hour is their appointed time—the Hour is more disastrous, and most bitter

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٖ
translation: The wicked are in confusion and madness

arabic: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
translation: The Day when they are dragged upon their faces into the Fire: “Taste the touch of Saqar.”

arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٖ
translation: Everything We created is precisely measured

arabic: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٞ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
translation: And Our command is but once, like the twinkling of an eye

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
translation: We have destroyed your likes. Is there anyone who would ponder

arabic: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٖ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation: Everything they have done is in the Books

arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٖ وَكَبِيرٖ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
translation: Everything, small or large, is written down

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَهَرٖ
translation: The righteous will be amidst gardens and rivers

arabic: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
translation: In an assembly of virtue, in the presence of an Omnipotent King
